en.text: For this cause I, Paul, am the prisoner of Christ Jesus on behalf of you Gentiles,

zhSimplified.text: 因此，我—保罗为你们外邦人作了基督耶稣被囚的，替你们祈祷。

footnotes.text: - 3:1 此句是照对十四节所加

zhTraditional.text: 因此，我－保羅為你們外邦人作了基督耶穌被囚的，替你們祈禱。

footnotes.text: - 3:1 此句是照對十四節所加

en.text: if it is so that you have heard of the administration of that grace of God which was given me toward you,

zhSimplified.text: 谅必你们曾听见 神赐恩给我，将关切你们的职分托付我，

zhTraditional.text: 諒必你們曾聽見上帝賜恩給我，將關切你們的職分託付我，

en.text: how that by revelation the mystery was made known to me, as I wrote before in few words,

zhSimplified.text: 用启示使我知道福音的奥秘，正如我以前略略写过的。

zhTraditional.text: 用啟示使我知道福音的奧祕，正如我以前略略寫過的。

en.text: by which, when you read, you can perceive my understanding in the mystery of Christ,

zhSimplified.text: 你们念了，就能晓得我深知基督的奥秘。

zhTraditional.text: 你們念了，就能曉得我深知基督的奧祕。

en.text: which in other generations was not made known to the children of men, as it has now been revealed to his holy apostles and prophets in the Spirit,

zhSimplified.text: 这奥秘在以前的世代没有叫人知道，像如今借着圣灵启示他的圣使徒和先知一样。

zhTraditional.text: 這奧祕在以前的世代沒有叫人知道，像如今藉着聖靈啟示他的聖使徒和先知一樣。

en.text: that the Gentiles are fellow heirs and fellow members of the body, and fellow partakers of his promise in Christ Jesus through the Good News,

zhSimplified.text: 这奥秘就是外邦人在基督耶稣里，借着福音，得以同为后嗣，同为一体，同蒙应许。

zhTraditional.text: 這奧祕就是外邦人在基督耶穌裏，藉着福音，得以同為後嗣，同為一體，同蒙應許。

en.text: of which I was made a servant according to the gift of that grace of God which was given me according to the working of his power.

zhSimplified.text: 我作了这福音的执事，是照 神的恩赐，这恩赐是照他运行的大能赐给我的。

zhTraditional.text: 我作了這福音的執事，是照上帝的恩賜，這恩賜是照他運行的大能賜給我的。

en.text: To me, the very least of all saints, was this grace given, to preach to the Gentiles the unsearchable riches of Christ,

zhSimplified.text: 我本来比众圣徒中最小的还小，然而他还赐我这恩典，叫我把基督那测不透的丰富传给外邦人，

zhTraditional.text: 我本來比眾聖徒中最小的還小，然而他還賜我這恩典，叫我把基督那測不透的豐富傳給外邦人，

en.text: and to make all men see what is the administration of the mystery which for ages has been hidden in God, who created all things through Jesus Christ,

zhSimplified.text: 又使众人都明白，这历代以来隐藏在创造万物之 神里的奥秘是如何安排的，

zhTraditional.text: 又使眾人都明白，這歷代以來隱藏在創造萬物之上帝裏的奧祕是如何安排的，

en.text: to the intent that now through the assembly the manifold wisdom of God might be made known to the principalities and the powers in the heavenly places,

zhSimplified.text: 为要借着教会使天上执政的、掌权的，现在得知 神百般的智慧。

zhTraditional.text: 為要藉着教會使天上執政的、掌權的，現在得知上帝百般的智慧。

en.text: according to the eternal purpose which he accomplished in Christ Jesus our Lord.

zhSimplified.text: 这是照 神从万世以前，在我们主基督耶稣里所定的旨意。

zhTraditional.text: 這是照上帝從萬世以前，在我們主基督耶穌裏所定的旨意。

en.text: In him we have boldness and access in confidence through our faith in him.

zhSimplified.text: 我们因信耶稣，就在他里面放胆无惧，笃信不疑地来到 神面前。

zhTraditional.text: 我們因信耶穌，就在他裏面放膽無懼，篤信不疑地來到上帝面前。

en.text: Therefore I ask that you may not lose heart at my troubles for you, which are your glory.

zhSimplified.text: 所以，我求你们不要因我为你们所受的患难丧胆，这原是你们的荣耀。

zhTraditional.text: 所以，我求你們不要因我為你們所受的患難喪膽，這原是你們的榮耀。

en.text: For this cause, I bow my knees to the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ,

zhSimplified.text: 因此，我在父面前屈膝，（

zhTraditional.text: 因此，我在父面前屈膝，（

en.text: from whom every family in heaven and on earth is named,

zhSimplified.text: 天上地上的各家，都是从他得名。）

zhTraditional.text: 天上地上的各家，都是從他得名。）

en.text: that he would grant you, according to the riches of his glory, that you may be strengthened with power through his Spirit in the inner person,

zhSimplified.text: 求他按着他丰盛的荣耀，借着他的灵，叫你们心里的力量刚强起来，

zhTraditional.text: 求他按着他豐盛的榮耀，藉着他的靈，叫你們心裏的力量剛強起來，

en.text: that Christ may dwell in your hearts through faith, to the end that you, being rooted and grounded in love,

zhSimplified.text: 使基督因你们的信，住在你们心里，叫你们的爱心有根有基，

zhTraditional.text: 使基督因你們的信，住在你們心裏，叫你們的愛心有根有基，

en.text: may be strengthened to comprehend with all the saints what is the width and length and height and depth,

zhSimplified.text: 能以和众圣徒一同明白基督的爱是何等长阔高深，

zhTraditional.text: 能以和眾聖徒一同明白基督的愛是何等長闊高深，

en.text: and to know Christ’s love which surpasses knowledge, that you may be filled with all the fullness of God.

zhSimplified.text: 并知道这爱是过于人所能测度的，便叫 神一切所充满的，充满了你们。

zhTraditional.text: 並知道這愛是過於人所能測度的，便叫上帝一切所充滿的，充滿了你們。

en.text: Now to him who is able to do exceedingly abundantly above all that we ask or think, according to the power that works in us,

zhSimplified.text: 神能照着运行在我们心里的大力充充足足地成就一切，超过我们所求所想的。

zhTraditional.text: 上帝能照着運行在我們心裏的大力充充足足地成就一切，超過我們所求所想的。

en.text: to him be the glory in the assembly and in Christ Jesus to all generations, forever and ever. Amen.

zhSimplified.text: 但愿他在教会中，并在基督耶稣里，得着荣耀，直到世世代代，永永远远。阿们！

zhTraditional.text: 但願他在教會中，並在基督耶穌裏，得着榮耀，直到世世代代，永永遠遠。阿們！
